scope: Lower recovery for the declared development readers is not protection against every reader.
MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used: development evidence, never confirmation.
Versions share training rows; repetitions share households; reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets.
A reserve-frontier result is not superiority over every historical method.
Novelty is never inferred from performance.
The two source versions share every training row and the MODEL_SELECT people: procedure repeats, not replications.
Cached MODEL_FIT out-of-fold statistics are derived from MODEL_FIT training labels (income, occupation, SEX).
A better optimizer of the stated objective is not a novel privacy algorithm.
advancement_own.statement: the optimizer-repair hypothesis closes: the original solver matches the applicable reference, or a revised solver improves only the surrogate objective without a usefulness / recovery rationale
